novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new mechanism/measurement route: “the prompt-final hidden state (before any reasoning token is emitted) linearly encodes an expected-length / budget prior” that is shifted by superficial wording independently of difficulty and then causally sets trace length. The closest retrieved work includes “Activation Control for Efficiently Eliciting Long Chain-of-thought Ability of Language Models” and “Activation Steering for Chain-of-Thought Compression,” found using searches such as “pre-generation hidden state reasoning length prior,” “prompt boundary activation trace length,” “activation steering CoT length,” and “surface prompt features reasoning budget”; these steer or decode length-related states, but do not establish this pre-token, difficulty-independent anchoring relationship, while Re-FORC addresses upfront reward/length prediction rather than a self-fulfilling latent budget prior. Thus the step from prior work is not merely changing the model or dataset, nor merely renaming standard probing/steering: it requires a new core relationship between prompt-boundary state, superficial cues, and causally self-fulfilling reasoning length, supporting high but within-framework novelty rather than paradigm-level novelty.
